text:
emma: rolled out seq-aware microbatch + early-ack cache priming to canary (5%) at 12:13 PT. quick snapshot looks good. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy release/seq-aware-microbatch-early-priming -> canary-us-west (id: dpl_20260325_09)

emma: numbers: short-prompt p50 ~170ms -> ~95ms, p95 ~410ms -> ~255ms. tokens/sec +18%. estimated slice cost -14%.

kai: awesome. where are the dashboards? can you drop links to the queries?

emma: dash: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/seq/earlyprime. query = request_latency{route="text.generate"}. perf sample attached in thread.

rachel: any negatives for long-context flows? we changed priming behavior so curious about eviction/thrashing.

emma: tested on 8k; eviction rate stable. long-context p50 +6ms, p95 unchanged. priming uses soft-affinity to avoid evicting active sessions.

metric-bot: snapshot: requests=2804, primed=1148, priming_latency_avg=20ms, median_batch=3, p50_down=75ms, p95_down=155ms

kai: rollout plan?

emma: ramping to 25% in 30m if no anomalies. monitor: cache_hit_rate, batch_size_dist, gpu_util, retry_rate, p99 latency, GC pauses.

ops-bot: @oncall notified with summary: "Seq-aware microbatch + early-ack priming canary live (5%)."

rachel: please add a 1-line blurb for the product weekly and update the release notes with the numbers. support will likely ask about cost savings.

emma: added to release doc and console banner draft. infra-toggle only for now; we'll surface Optimize recommendation later.

kai: nice work team :tada:

emma: thanks — ping here with any odd spikes."
